name: Setup SSH
description: Adds ssh keys for current user to machine

activate-with-label.description: Tells the action only to add keys when specific label is applied, set false if you want the key to always be added

remove-existing-keys.description: Removes existing keys at ~/.ssh/authorized_keys before adding new ones

instructions.description: Additional instructions on what to do next

fail-silently.description: If set to true, action will always succeed even if it failed to fetch the keys or determine hosts IP address
